name: Mother Puckers | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Sour Berry Burst
description:
Flavor That Fights Back.
Mother Puckers Sour Berry Burst Super Sour Chews bring the chaos with four bold, juicy berry flavors—each gummy coated in our signature sour sugar for a face-puckering punch followed by a mouthwatering sweet finish. No blends. No confusion. Just pure berry-flavored rebellion in every bite: Wildberry, Blueberry, Sour Raspberry, and Cloudberry.

These chews don’t just taste good—they hit. Infused with 200mg of THC from premium Live Rosin, this Hybrid formula delivers full-spectrum potency with terpene-rich effects that lift you up and keep you smiling. It’s balanced, flavorful, and dangerously craveable.

Loud flavors. Loud effects. Loud brand! Vegan, gluten-free, heat-resistant. #PAFO
